comment: Folded in from github.com/marcfuentes/dustbox-zdl (MIT, (c) 2026 Marcelo Fuentes). DOD FX33 Buzz Box-style distortion plus a flip-flop sub-octave. PEDAL BUILD manifest for Dustbox (4-knob). build.py reads THIS file; manifest.json is the desktop-preview manifest. Blue Box octave is a zero-crossing flip-flop divider (relocation-free: no arrays, no math lib, no runtime divide). Renamed off the original DOD/FX33/Buzz branding to a vacuum-cleaner theme.
gid_comment: 0x08 = Delay category -> SONAME prefix ZDL_DLY_ / Fx_DLY_.

params.name: Dust
params.comment: params[5]. (was Heavy) Blend distortion (0) <-> sub-octave fuzz (100, 2 octaves down). The ONLY knob that adds the octave; at 0 no octave is present. Knob 1, matching the real FX33's Heavy/Buzz/Saw/Thrust layout order.

params.name: Motor
params.comment: params[6]. (was Buzz) Gain / distortion amount only -- never adds the octave.

params.name: Filter
params.comment: params[7]. (was Saw) Tone: single high-shelf. 0 = dark, 50 = flat, 100 = bright.

params.name: Power
params.comment: Output level. Raised from the original's default of 1 so the effect is audible when selected, matching the rest of this pack. Note this is a LEVEL, not a dry/wet crossfade -- Dustbox's blend is Dust, which fades between the distortion and the octave branch rather than against dry.

audio_nop_comment: Set true for a UI-only smoke build before trusting the DSP.
